questions.questionHtml:
Consider two given C programs. Which of the following is/are true? It is also known that in C programming, &&&& has higher precedence than ||.||.

  1. Program 1
  2. #include<stdio.h>
  3. void main()
  4. {
  5.     int i = 0;
  6.     if (++i && (i==0))
  7.         printf(“GO Classes\n”);
  8.     else
  9.         printf(“GATEOverflow\n”);
  10. }
  1. Program 2
  2. #include<stdio.h>
  3. void main()
  4. {
  5.     int x, y, z;
  6.     x = 1;
  7.     y = z = 0;
  8.     ++x || ++y && ++z;
  9.     if (y || z)
  10.         printf(“GO Classes\n”);
  11.     else
  12.         printf(“GATEOverflow\n”);
  13. }
